page.overview:
What is Punk Records?

Punk Records was an area in the Labophase of Egghead which stores the brain of Dr. Vegapunk. It acts as a "library" which Vegapunk and his six satellites can remotely connect to, allowing them to share the same brain.

Following the conclusion of the Egghead Incident, it became disconnected from the island and floated away into the sky. This was done by Edison to prevent York from being able to physically activate it and handing it over to the World Government.

The exterior of Punk Records resembles a broken egg half facing downwards. Inside the egg is a flat black surface with a light grid pattern and the text "PUNK RECORDS" written on it. A ring composed of blocks is floating around the structure. There is a trapdoor access to the interior one tile below the space between the R and E.

The interior of Punk Records contains Vegapunk's oversized and perpetually growing brain, still within his scalp that he cut off years ago, stored inside a liquid tank supported by various machinery.
